codes.name: Receptacle, plastic
codes.beschreibung_en: Containment vessel made of plastic for retaining substances or articles.

codes.name: Pallet
codes.beschreibung_en: Platform or open-ended box, usually made of wood, on which goods are retained for ease of mechanical handling during transport and storage.

codes.name: Box, wooden, natural wood, with sift proof walls
Reel
codes.beschreibung_en: Cylindrical rotatory device with a rim at each end on which materials are wound.

codes.name: Rednet
codes.beschreibung_en: Containment material made of red mesh netting for retaining articles (e.g. trees).

codes.name: Skid
codes.beschreibung_en: A low movable platform or pallet to facilitate the handling and transport of goods.

codes.name: Slipsheet
codes.beschreibung_en: Hard plastic sheeting primarily used as the base on which to stack goods to optimise the space within a container. May be used as an alternative to a palletized packaging.

codes.name: Spool
codes.beschreibung_en: A packaging container used in the transport of such items as wire, cable, tape and yarn.

codes.name: Shrinkwrapped
codes.beschreibung_en: Goods retained in a transparent plastic film that has been wrapped around and then shrunk tightly on to the goods.

codes.name: Tablet
codes.beschreibung_en: A loose or unpacked article in the form of a bar, block or piece.

codes.name: Tyre
codes.beschreibung_en: A ring made of rubber and/or metal surrounding a wheel.

codes.name: Tank container, generic
codes.beschreibung_en: A specially constructed container for transporting liquids and gases in bulk.

codes.name: Bag, tote
codes.beschreibung_en: A capacious bag or basket.

codes.name: Tube, with nozzle
codes.beschreibung_en: A tube made of plastic, metal or cardboard fitted with a nozzle, containing a liquid or semi-liquid product, e.g. silicon.

codes.name: Pallet, triwall
codes.beschreibung_en: A lightweight pallet made from heavy duty corrugated board.

codes.name: Unit
codes.beschreibung_en: A type of package composed of a single item or object, not otherwise specified as a unit of transport equipment.

codes.name: Vanpack
codes.beschreibung_en: A type of wooden crate.

codes.name: Vehicle
codes.beschreibung_en: A self-propelled means of conveyance.

codes.name: Bulk, scrap metal
codes.beschreibung_en: Loose or unpacked scrap metal transported in bulk form.

codes.name: Intermediate bulk container
codes.beschreibung_en: A reusable container made of metal, plastic, textile, wood or composite materials used to facilitate transportation of bulk solids and liquids in manageable volumes.
